gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests that a {@link PaxDate} can be converted to the equivalent ISO {@link LocalDate} via {@link LocalDate#from(java.time.temporal.TemporalAccessor)}.

Each
ADDED i2: Supplies {@code (paxDate, expectedIsoDate)} pairs covering a range of calendar features: the epoch boundary, leap years (with the inserted one-week 'Pax' month)
ADDED i3: Start of the Pax epoch, mapping back one day into ISO year 0
ADDED i4: Year 6 is a leap year: month 13 is the short 'Pax' month, month 14 follows
ADDED i5: Year 399 is a leap year; year 400 is not (divisible by 400)
ADDED i6: Year 0 (a non-leap year at the era boundary)
ADDED i7: Assorted historically notable dates
ADDED i8: 'Before Current Era': negative proleptic years
